humanDirectionSubsequentlyReported: Explicit wake endpoint (Recommended) approved; no activation, model use or UI work. Root will pin auth clarification before runtime code.
assessment: Explicit owner-wide authenticated wake over unchanged I5 is a coherent bounded dependency. Admission/owner/record/cooldown/coalescing/two-cycle/elapsed limits, default-off flags, bounded acknowledgement, explicit context exit and honest close/restart limitations avoid a new durable queue or approval authority. Four focused gates plus affected governance are proportionate; no old matrix is needed.

conditionsBeforeCode.condition: Derive exact internal ID/email from the validated bearer sessions.user_id and its current user row, preserving session TTL/verification policy and the existing public DTO. userForToken/resolveUser returns publicUser without ID; do not remap its email through getUserId after an await. That can bind an old token resolution to a newly recreated account. Reject changed identity before/after I5 session opening and test the deletion/recreation seam.

Treat admitting slots as part of job lifetime: after asynchronous policy opening, recheck closed/aborted/elapsed state before acknowledging or starting pickup. A pending admission resolved after close/deadline must not produce a late202 or launch work. Cover this in the new coordinator unit lifecycle cases; this implements the stated close/deadline contract.

scopeNotes: Wake authorizes a bounded owner-wide scan, not just one current project; acknowledgement promises neither completion nor full drain.
Existing submit/decide routes retain their effects; a future UI may call durable action then explicit wake in one interaction only under its separately agreed UI scope.
Logout does not cancel admitted work; cancellation/account eligibility and canonical fences remain authoritative. No atomic in-flight revocation or immediate server.close-initiation abort claim.
Create job resources/open/pickup/follow-up/finalization under deliberately empty account and meter contexts; runAsAccount(null) does not clear inherited context.
No automatic trigger, daemon, HTTP status capability, provider fallback, activation, real model use or dependent UI implementation authorized by this review.

execution.note: Read-only plan and relevant source-seam inspection; only this permitted review file written, no Git/state/runtime changes.

stopPoint: Pin the clarification and approved explicit-trigger contract before code. Separate exact-source implementation review remains required; root retains all slots.
